description: Freight Analysis Framework (FAF5) Highway Network Assignments is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). The Freight Analysis Framework (FAF5) - Highway Network Assignments was created from 2017 base year and 30 year forecast data and was published on April 11, 2022 from the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). Its keywords are USA, National, NTAD, National Transportation Atlas Database, Transportation, Atlas, Database, table. The bounding box given is 0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.0000. The hub shows 2025-10-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
